Let me locate the dots on this tool:
- Yellow dot: at the top, on the head/open end of the wrench.
- Green dot: on the head/jaw area of the wrench.
- Blue dot: on the lower part, which is the handle/shaft of the wrench.
- Purple dot: this is on the orange dropper/pipette object to the right, not on the wrench.

So the handle of the wrench is the long part pointing down. The blue dot is on that handle.

The green dot is on the head (the jaw part). The yellow dot is on the very top of the head.

Thus the answer is D (Blue).

Let me double check by examining coordinates. The wrench head is around y=280-330, handle extends from y=330 to y=450. The blue dot is at approximately (805, 408), which is on the handle. The green dot is at (818, 302), on the head. Yellow at (821, 274), top of head. Purple at (1237, 401), on the orange object.

Therefore the blue dot is on the handle.

Answer: D.
